description: Route authorized software work through one durable, capacity-aware subscription policy.

interface.longDescription: The bundled Prism runtime behind Chromeria's Prism tools: a planner thread in T3 submits a job, and one durable runner routes its dispatcher and workers as T3 threads to one open PR.
